note: same key twice after a consonant: independent vowel
five presses: sign + two independent vowels
a run outside a consonant context does not pair
another vowel key after a sign: independent vowel
Space ends a run and the word
a vowel after Space is independent
Backspace keeps the word: a vowel after a kept consonant is a sign
Backspace inside a run: the kept consonant still gives a sign
Backspace removes the sign, the next press types it again
after a kept sign: independent vowel
